snippet.title: Labyrinth - A Free Maze Horror Game
snippet.description:
READ: There ARE monsters in the game.  I disabled them for the video so that the video wouldn't be interrupted.

Also, the anticlimactic "hole" in this video has been replaced with a proper exit portal starting from Demo Release 2.

For the past month or so, I've been working on this game in my free time.  I call it "Labyrinth" (original, right?), and it's basically a game that takes place in a dark labyrinth with monsters roaming the randomly gnerated maze.  The objective of the game is to get to the end without dying.

Did I mention you have no weapons?

Current version (as of December 31 2012): Release 1

http://www.indiedb.com/games/labyrinthhorror
http://labyrinthhorror.blogspot.com/

Note: The maze is randomly generated.  You will never have the same maze twice!

Please read all the TXT files in the ZIP file before playing the game, especially the controls.

Misc Information:
Programmed with C#/.NET 4.0 and XNA 4.0
The game uses the Maze Knockdown Algorithm to generate the maze.
Inspired by Slender and Amnesia: the Dark Descent.
